# GPay Activity Studio

> A browser tool that turns a Google Pay Takeout My Activity.html file into spend, transfer, merchant, and trend views.

Parsing and the charts run in the browser. The file is not uploaded.

- Site: https://spend-analyser-gpay.biradarakshay.com/
- Author: Akshay Biradar
- Author site: https://www.biradarakshay.com/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/biradar-akshay/
- GitHub: https://github.com/akshay11168

## What this site does not do

It does not store the activity file, upload transactions, connect to a Google account, or keep a spending history after the tab is closed.
